# Real Paired Single-Cell Multiomics Benchmark Dataset (Rice Bud, Seurat v5 Option B)

A real, pre-processed paired single-cell RNA-seq and ATAC-seq benchmark
dataset of rice bud tissue (*Oryza sativa*, GEO accession GSE232863),
packaged in **Option B (Strict S4 Standardization)** using `Seurat` v5
objects. Contains paired empirical reference profiles (200 shared
top-expressed genes x 100 cells for RNA, 200 shared top-accessible peaks
x 100 cells for ATAC) across 4 major biological cell types
(`Bud_primordium`, `Epidermis`, `Parenchyma_cell`, `Root_meristem`, 25
cells each) and 2 biological batches (`Bud_21`, `Bud_22`), alongside
simulated outputs from 6 major single-cell multiomics simulators
(`scMultiSim`, `scDesign3`, `MOSim`, `scCross`, `scMoMtF`, and
`Matilda`) and observed scalability benchmarks (runtime in seconds and
peak RAM in MiB).

## Usage

``` r
data(example_rice_bud)
```

## Format

A list with 4 elements:

- metadata:

  List containing organism, tissue, GEO accession (GSE232863), data type
  (Paired), and description.

- reference:

  List containing Option B standardized `Seurat` v5 objects: `combined`
  (multi-modal `Seurat` with `RNA` 200 x 100, `ATAC` 200 x 100,
  `cell_type`, `batch`, and `integrated`/`pca` reductions), `rna`
  (unimodal `Seurat` object for scRNA-seq / Shiny upload), and `atac`
  (unimodal `Seurat` object for scATAC-seq / Shiny upload).

- simulated:

  Named list of simulated outputs for 6 simulators: `scMultiSim`,
  `scDesign3`, `MOSim`, `scCross`, `scMoMtF`, and `Matilda`. Each
  simulator entry contains `combined`, `rna`, and `atac` `Seurat`
  objects matching the reference structure.

- scalability_benchmarks:

  A data.frame with benchmarked `Method`, `Runtime_Seconds`, and
  `PeakRAM_MiB`.

## Source

Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) GSE232863. Preprocessed via standard rice
tissue pipeline.

## Examples

``` r
data(example_rice_bud)
example_rice_bud$reference$combined
#> An object of class Seurat 
#> 400 features across 100 samples within 2 assays 
#> Active assay: RNA (200 features, 0 variable features)
#>  1 layer present: counts
#>  1 other assay present: ATAC
#>  2 dimensional reductions calculated: integrated, pca
dim(example_rice_bud$reference$rna)
#> [1] 200 100
dim(example_rice_bud$reference$atac)
#> [1] 200 100
names(example_rice_bud$simulated)
#> [1] "scMultiSim" "scDesign3"  "MOSim"      "scCross"    "scMoMtF"   
#> [6] "Matilda"   
# \donttest{
evaluate_multiomics_accuracy(
  ref_multi = example_rice_bud$reference$combined,
  sim_multi = example_rice_bud$simulated$scMultiSim$combined,
  pairing   = "paired"
)
```
